shared_elements: bird-headed or bird forms in profile
symmetrically paired figures flanking a central axis
repeated small emblematic signs covering the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief anthropomorphic figures, a prominent disc/ring motif, bird-like profile forms and mirrored pairs arranged about a central vertical axis, but these are generic correspondences any relief tradition could reach independently. B is a register-organised scene of slender, detailed elongated human figures with raised arms beneath a rayed disc, framed by columns of dense script signs, whereas A is a sparse arrangement of isolated, heavily schematised emblems and squat crouching bird-headed forms on a curved sculptural body, with no registers, no script and no rayed disc.
